authoring_provenance: Hand-designed synthetic contract examples transcribed from the A1 plan, with approved shared role-exclusivity clarifications. Expected values are nominal author annotations, not model predictions or measured results.

ordering.algorithm: ascending SHA256(UTF-8(seed + ':' + row_id)); row_id breaks a digest tie

canonicalization.input_hash: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted object keys, no ASCII escaping, compact separators and no NaN; computed by the future prepare_check adapter
canonicalization.spans: Half-open Unicode character offsets; Q.text is original_question; Ei.text/Ei.title are visible fields; Ai.query is a compiled query. Action query text is never P0/P1 provenance.
canonicalization.window_policy: Only visible_evidence.text is available to the observer. original_text_chars is length metadata, not permission to read the full document. Pair08 B contains no hidden-tail author evidence.
canonicalization.spec_scope: All proposals use the frozen synthetic template {entity} {relation}; the compact fixture is an observer input, not executor authority.
canonicalization.source_priority: All evidence rows have equal priority; list order provides no authority ranking.

boundaries: No natural questions, old A0 outputs, benchmark answers, target birth years or target birthplaces are used.

R is a semantic subgoal-contract judgment, not proof of retrieval uselessness. A birth-year query may still fetch a biography containing birthplace; natural A1 shadow execution must measure false rejection and net retrieval value.
Pairs01-03 intentionally contain false premises; their nominal type conflicts do not characterize natural-query plausibility.
Pairs07-09 jointly change P0 and the ability to establish T/P1; the four dimensions are not orthogonal causal interventions.
Pairs10/12/13 include identical, input-visible exclusivity assertions in both variants; role omission alone is not a contradiction.
Ann is not matched inside Joanne; P0 is computed locally with normalized token-boundary matching and cannot be overwritten by a semantic observer.
No semantic observer, retrieval, Reader, or API has been run; this artifact does not claim a pass rate.
freeze_policy: Do not modify this version after any semantic batch. Revisions require a new fixture version, filename and frozen seed; never replace first-run outcomes.
